message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "To avoid legal problems linked to centralized link sites, the decentralized BitTorrent project eXeem, created by the makers of SuprNova.org, entered beta in late 2004. This project sought to remove the requirement for outside torrent link sites and trackers. It let users publish and share new files directly on the network without using dedicated servers. This approach tried to fix the legal troubles that caused the shutdown of its parent organization's link site."}
